title: Mouse627 installed native evidence file bundle
$comment: Logical bundle of six627 proof JSON files, retained623 fixed-viewport/lifecycle/agent evidence and retained626 palette evidence. mouse627-release.py verifies cross-frame geometry, signed simultaneous movement, exact captured surface membership, page identity/viewport/scroll equality, bounded native work, required PNG signatures and source/installed evidence. The former626 Nora morph and623 expanding/seam contract are explicitly superseded; all release security, profile and actual625 update gates remain. The PNG extension list covers627 and the retained626 palette; additional historical captures remain required by the publisher. Desktop capture pixel probes use measured exposed BODY coordinates mapped to native PNG pixels, including zoom/Retina scale.

const.reason: Fixed-size compositor slide replaces the former contour morph

desktopTransition.$comment: Python validator requires four unique theme/direction pairs, exactly one250ms acknowledgement, animationDurationMs<=660+ackDelayMs, unchanged two tracked page pins and full frame membership matching captures[].ids, including all pre-existing native pages. Both forward transitions also require framebuffer PNG proof of simultaneous fixture surfaces; the reverse transitions retain full identity/layout/RAF acceptance.

noraPresentation.$comment: The Python validator independently decodes the exact saved RGB/RGBA PNG, matches every recorded sample and requires a three-column outline/fill boundary at an intermediate vertical translation. Logical DOM samples alone cannot establish the captured frame.

desktopPresentation.$comment: The Python validator recomputes both band counts from the archived PNG at the exact recorded viewport rows and requires >=ceil(16*pixelWidth/viewportWidth) opaque pixels of each fixture colour.

pdfPresentation.$comment: The Python validator requires twelve separated dark source-canvas glyph points, matched in the actual edit-mode framebuffer within the recorded Retina-scaled pixel neighbourhood. It verifies those opaque dark pixels in the exact archived PNG; an overlay-blurred or blank page fails.
